title: Drawing a person, a wavy wave and eyes with the house ideas
description: A person, a wavy wave and a pair of eyes are drawn using the same tools as the house. A circle gives the head, equal half circles give the wave, and two arcs from points above and below a line give each eye.
teaching_notes: One idea: the compass, the perpendicular and the same opening used twice can draw many figures. Watch for students who draw the eyes freehand instead of with matching arcs.

video_script.why: A learner uses the compass and the set square of the house construction to draw three new figures from the artwork pages.
video_script.substitution: a person from a circle and a square, a wave from equal half circles, and eyes from two matching arcs
video_script.anchor: three small pictures on the board: a person, a wavy wave and a pair of eyes
video_script.payoff_line: All three figures are drawn with a compass and a set square, using the house ideas.

final_answer.value: an open drawing: a person with a circle head and square body, a wave of equal half circles, and two matching eyes
final_answer.spoken: all three figures are drawn with a compass and a set square

maths_rules: person: a circle for the head, a short neck line and a square for the body
wave: equal half circles drawn alternately above and below a central line
eyes: an upper arc from a point below the line and a lower arc from a point above it, with the same compass opening
the two compass points are placed the same distance from the line, so the eye is symmetrical
video_script.design: Three small pictures stay on the board. Each is built in turn with the compass and the set square, and the same compass opening is used twice for each eye.
